page.text:
Having defined individual connectives and their algebraic laws, we now
turn to the overarching semantic framework of propositional logic. We
wish to understand how the truth value of an arbitrary, arbitrarily
nested formula is determined by the values of its atomic variables, and
what totality of functions can be expressed within this syntax.
